# KoflCraft status

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask status` from docs/features.toml. Do not edit. -->

The verification grade of every feature (AG-17), how it was checked and what is still missing. A partial result is never presented as success; every tool result also carries a `limitations` list.

- **verified** (9): checked against an exact or independent reference by a named test
- **partial** (16): works on the named fixtures, with known gaps
- **unverified** (1): built, not yet checked
- **open** (0): not built

FoehnCraft max non-orthogonality: pipe 23.3° (TFI 23.4°), elbow 23.45° (TFI 23.7°, MB1b smoother 34.5° to 38.7°); wall angle max pipe 3.12° → 0.44°, elbow 3.17° → 0.63°; extruded NACA 2412 C-grid with one span cell now smoothed: wall angle max 60.4° → 34.5°, non-orthogonality 60.4° → 55.9°, skewness 0.267 → 0.155. The acceptance runner builds pipe, elbow and an extruded NACA 2412 C-grid with TFI and elliptic smoothing, has FoehnCraft read each VTU and MSH back against the evidence, and fails if smoothing raises the max non-orthogonality FoehnCraft measures (first run: pipe 23.39° → 23.30°, elbow 23.77° → 23.58°, airfoil 60.54° → 47.00°) | Interior skew from TFI away from walls stays (pipe 23.3° where the MB1b smoother reached 19.3°; airfoil worst cell 55.9° below the leading edge); the airfoil C-grid needs about 2,500 sweeps (35 s for 11,520 cells); Thomas–Middlecoff controls were measured and not kept; non-planar symmetry patches stay fixed | BS-08, BS-09, BS-12 |
| Block-structured variant MB1e: block.* edit tools (list, counts, laws, curves, vertices, blocks, split, patches) | partial | block.list reads a topology with vertices, blocks, edges, patches, surfaces and chains; block.set_count sets the count of the whole chain of opposite edges through one edge; block.set_distribution and block.set_edge_curve set one edge, given from either end and stored in the file's edge direction; block.move_vertex moves a vertex to a point or by an offset; block.set_patch renames a patch and sets its role; block.add_vertex, block.remove_vertex (unused only), block.add_block (open faces into a named patch, faces it closes leave their patches) and block.remove_block (opened faces into a named patch); block.split_block splits a block after a cell index and every block of its chain with it, new vertices on the TFI nodes and the halves' curves and laws fitted to the grid by arc length (pipe and channel splits keep every node to 3e-14, the NACA 2412 wall to 1.5e-8 chords). Each edit writes a new file that passed the check, or is refused with BLOCK001 and writes nothing; geometric edits remove the template's analytic reference; the chain replays from the journal | After a split, interior nodes follow the TFI of the new blocks, not of the whole (NACA 2412: up to 2.2e-3 chords; elbow: projected wall face interiors slide along the torus by 4.8e-5 at radius 0.5); a split whose chain reaches a block twice in different ways is refused; no tools for projection surfaces, merging blocks or collapsed blocks; a refused edit lists every follow-on issue of the check, not only the first cause | BS-04, BS-05 |
| Block-structured variant MB1f: wall nodes slide along curved section contours during elliptic smoothing | partial | block.grid with {"kind": "elliptic", "wall_sliding": true} chains the wall nodes along the curved lines of ruled wall faces (extruded sections), joined across blocks where the line turns by less than 30°; chain ends and sharper corners (trailing edges) stay. After each sweep a node moves halfway to the foot of its first off-wall node on a spline through the TFI wall nodes, inside half a TFI cell of its start; block vertices on the section slide with the edge nodes. Without the window the foot point drifts the whole distribution toward the leading edge and folds the grid (NACA 2412: 13 % of chord). NACA 2412 C-grid, 48 surface cells: largest wall angle 15.5° → 11.0°, min scaled Jacobian 0.58 → 0.62, wall nodes within 5e-6 chords of the section; FoehnCraft max non-orthogonality on the acceptance C-grid 47.0° → 44.7° (TFI 60.5°). wall_sliding without wall_orthogonality is refused | Walls on projection surfaces (pipe cylinder, elbow torus) do not slide: the foot-point rule drifts at O-grid corners, where the off-wall node sits on an inner block edge and follows the wall node (measured: pipe wall angle 0.4° → 4.8°); no multi-element template yet to measure the case it is for; the contour is a polyline with 32 samples per cell of the spline through the TFI nodes, not the section itself (wall nodes off by up to 8e-6 chords) | BS-09, BS-12 |
